review.reviewer: Float ETA desktop agency, imagery and downstream-network review
review.note: AGFC identifies the Kings River corridor and Arkansas Tourism describes its free-flowing character. These reviewed reaches are upstream of Table Rock Lake; the NHD line follows the river between the agency landing records. Geometry, endpoint and mileage checks pass. This does not establish current floatability, enable GPS ETA or change calculator distances.
